strip.title: Photos for "{q}"
strip.hint: Tap a photo to add it to this product. It is copied into your media library.

sharing.label: Let other sellers use my product photos
sharing.help: Your live product photos can be suggested to other shops selling the same item. They get their own copy; yours never change.
sharing.picked: used by other shops {n} time | used by other shops {n} times

admin.title: Stock photos
admin.subtitle: Photos suggested to sellers while they type a product name. Add keywords in every language customers use — English, ລາວ, ไทย — so "beer lao", "ເບຍລາວ" and "เบียร์ลาว" all find the same photo.
admin.choose: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP
admin.keywordsPh: beer, bottle, ເບຍລາວ, เบียร์ลาว
admin.rights: Only add photos you have the right to share with every seller (your own shots, a brand's press kit, or with the owner's permission).
admin.uploaded: Photo added to the stock library.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete "{title}"? Shops that already picked it keep their copy.
admin.emptyText: Upload brand shots and common products so sellers can list faster.
admin.promoteIntro: Find product photos in shops (for example a brand's official distributor) and copy them into the stock library. Ask the shop for permission first.
admin.promoteHelp: A copy of this photo from {shop} goes into the stock library. The shop's own photo is not changed.
admin.synIntro: Words that mean the same product. Typing any of them finds photos tagged with the others. Spaces and capitals don't matter.
admin.synPh: Comma separated, e.g. beer lao, ເບຍລາວ, เบียร์ลาว
